name: Reiner Gamma (centre), IM-3 target
note: Intuitive Machines' IM-3 (CLPS) targets the Reiner Gamma lunar swirl on the near side. No landing coordinates are published (checked 15 Nov 2026); this is the IAU centre of the swirl (58.96 W). Terrain from the 1.9 km global map.
source: IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, Reiner Gamma
provenance: Terrain: NASA LOLA LDEM_16 (~1.9 km/px, global). Ephemeris: JPL DE421 via Skyfield, MOON_ME frame. Curvature included, no refraction. Validated against JPL Horizons and NASA LOLA illumination maps.
